title: Long task trend (hourly, ms)
sqlTemplate: select histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') as bucket, count(*) as long_task_count, approx_percentile_cont(long_task_duration, 0.5) / 1000000.0 as p50_duration from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'long_task' group by bucket order by bucket asc limit 200
emptyDataSemantics: No matching long_task records in the window -> an empty result set (zero rows/buckets). Native long_task capture is best-effort (see docs/openobserve-v0.91-stream-capabilities.md, Stage 15) so an empty result here is expected and not itself an error.
